title: Testing Library Ecosystem
description: A family of utilities for testing UI components across frameworks.

data.text: The Testing Library ecosystem provides framework-specific packages that share the same guiding principle: test your app like a user does. It includes packages for React, Vue, Angular, Svelte, and plain DOM.

data.title: User Event Example
Philosophy
data.text: Testing Library encourages testing DOM nodes rather than component internals, leading to more resilient tests.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Testing Library supports all major UI frameworks
Queries reflect how users interact with the page
data.takeaway: The Testing Library ecosystem provides consistent, user-centric testing utilities for any frontend framework.
